description: This file defines the MatchRepository class, responsible for converting FilterPreferences into query parameters and delegating match fetching to MatchService. It centralizes filter-to-query mapping logic for the dating app's frontend.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class that handles translating filter preferences into query parameters and fetching matches from the MatchService.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Public method to fetch match items based on specified filter preferences.

methods.name: _mapFilters
methods.description: Internal method that maps FilterPreferences object into a map of query parameters for the backend.
